description_en: Switches workloads between primary and secondary ApsaraDB RDS instances
description_zh: 该接口用于RDS实例的手动主备切换
name: SwitchDBInstanceHA

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The secondary instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceHAConfig operation to query the secondary instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 备库的唯一标识，通过接口DescribeDBInstanceHAConfig可查询该值
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable forcible switching. Valid values:

Yes
No

Default value: No
parameters.help_zh:
切换方式，取值：
Yes：强制
No：非强制

默认值：No
parameters.name: force

parameters.help_en:
The time when the switching takes effect. Valid values:

Immediate: The switching immediately takes effect.
MaintainTime: The switching takes effect during the maintenance time.

Default value: Immediate
parameters.help_zh:
生效时间，取值：
Immediate：立即执行
MaintainTime：可维护时间内执行

默认值：Immediate
parameters.name: effective_time
